name: nuvanx-system
description: Unified workspace commands for Nuvanx System

scripts.test: node --test frontend/scripts/vercel-ci-gate.test.mjs && node scripts/lib/phone-normalization.test.js && node scripts/meta-apply-rsv26.concurrency.test.mjs && node scripts/populate-doctoralia-appointments.test.js && node scripts/sync-doctoralia.test.js && node --test scripts/scan-secrets.test.js && node --test scripts/sync-google-ads-insights.test.js && node --test scripts/google-ads-daily-owner.test.js && node --test scripts/provision-google-ads-developer-token.test.js && node --test scripts/preflight-google-ads-runtime.test.js && node --test scripts/converge-google-ads-edge-auth.test.js && node scripts/verify-meta-access.test.js && node scripts/validate-repository-hygiene.mjs && vitest run supabase/functions supabase/tests
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.supabase:types: npx --yes supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public > frontend/src/lib/supabase/types.ts
scripts.verify:doctoralia-config: node -e 'const checks=[["Doctoralia sheet ID",process.env.DOCTORALIA_APPOINTMENTS_SHEET_ID||process.env.DOCTORALIA_SHEET_ID||process.env.DOCTORALIA_DRIVE_FILE_ID],["DOCTORALIA_APPOINTMENTS_SHEET_NAME",process.env.DOCTORALIA_APPOINTMENTS_SHEET_NAME],["GOOGLE_DOCTORALIA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT",process.env.GOOGLE_DOCTORALIA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT],["DATABASE_URL",process.env.DATABASE_URL],["CLINIC_ID",process.env.CLINIC_ID]]; console.log("Verificando configuración de Doctoralia..."); let ok=true; for(const [name,value] of checks){if(String(value||"").trim()) console.log(`✅ ${name} configurada`); else {console.error(`❌ Falta variable: ${name}`); ok=false}} if(!ok) process.exit(1)'
